title: Revisiting N2DCG: An Empirically Grounded Reformulation of Carousel Recommendation Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2608.21877v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Carousel interfaces have been widely used in video and music streaming services, yet it remains unclear how to properly evaluate recommender systems in these two-dimensional layouts. N2DCG has been proposed to address this gap by adapting NDCG to carousel-based recommendation, but it relies on unverified assumptions borrowed from the single-list web-search setting that do not transfer well to two-dimensional carousel layouts.   We identify two substantial limitations of N2DCG: its ideal ranking, used for normalization, violates carousel constraints, and its discount function does not reflect user browsing behavior observed in empirical data. To address both limitations, we propose a reformulation of N2DCG that normalizes appropriately by respecting constraints and uses an empirically grounded discount function. translated_title: 重新审视N2DCG：基于实证的轮播推荐评估指标重构
translated_abstract: 轮播界面已广泛应用于视频和音乐流媒体服务中，但在这种二维布局下如何正确评估推荐系统仍不清楚。N2DCG被提出通过将NDCG适应于轮播推荐来解决这一差距，但它依赖于从单列表网页搜索设置中借用且未经验证的假设，这些假设不能很好地迁移到二维轮播布局中。我们识别出N2DCG的两个重大局限性：其用于归一化的理想排序违反了轮播约束，且其折扣函数未能反映实证数据中观察到的用户浏览行为。为解决这两个局限性，我们提出了一种N2DCG的重构版本，通过尊重约束进行适当归一化，并使用基于实证的折扣函数。我们验证了所提出的指标，表明它在真实眼动追踪数据上更好地反映了用户的实证行为。
tldr: 我们重构了N2DCG指标，通过修正归一化约束和采用实证折扣函数，使其更准确反映轮播推荐中用户的真实浏览行为。
en_tdlr: We reformulate the N2DCG metric by fixing normalization constraints and adopting an empirically grounded discount function, making it better reflect users' real browsing behavior in carousel recommendations.
